name: mimeo
tagline_zh: 把任意专家网页变成你的Agent技能文件，粘贴链接即得SKILL.md，连思考步骤和避坑提示都一并复印。
tagline_en: Turn any expert page into a SKILL.md for your agent—paste a link, get the full playbook, including reasoning and.
desc_en: Mimeograph an expert into a SKILL.md or AGENTS.md for your agent.
why_zh: 它不提炼要点，而是逐段复刻专家的决策路径与隐性经验，生成可直接挂载的结构化技能，比同类工具多一层可执行。
why_en: It doesn't summarize—it replicates the expert's decision path and tacit know-how into a ready-to-mount SKILL.md, adding a layer.
